name: Rechargeable COB Keychain Light
subtitle: USB-C charging with magnetic base
description: A compact COB keychain work light with USB-C charging, a 500mAh battery, and three lighting modes: High, Low, and Strobe. Its magnetic base and foldable stand provide hands-free positioning, while the keyring mount makes it suitable for carrying with everyday essentials.
story: This small work light is built around flexible placement rather than a fixed handheld torch shape. Attach the magnetic base to a suitable metal surface, open the foldable stand, or carry it from a keyring depending on the situation. The COB light panel provides the main illumination, with High, Low, and Strobe modes available from the device. USB-C charging avoids the need for disposable batteries. Its listed uses include workshop tasks, repairs, emergencies, and outdoor situations, while exact runtime is not provided.

specs.dimensions: Approximately 6 cm x 4 cm x 2 cm

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
